prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Style reference: the supplied simplified pastel aerial New York illustration. Carry forward its clean muted color blocks, restrained thin hand-drawn contours, subtle fine paper tooth, low saturation, romantic quiet mood and depth. Create a NEW scene, not the same aerial composition.
Scene: looking out at beautiful New York from inside a beautiful sunlit creative office. A generous floor-to-ceiling picture window occupies most of the image, with slender elegant warm-gray window mullions. We are inside a thoughtfully arranged, inviting high-floor office. Foreground: a simple pale oak desk near the window with a closed notebook, ceramic cup and small slim desk lamp, a comfortable chair, a leafy potted plant beside the window and a discreet vase with a few delicate branches. Calm, uncluttered, human-scaled, nothing luxurious or ostentatious.
Beyond the window: layered New York mid-rise and tall buildings with clean rooftop planes, a few water towers and rooftop gardens, distant avenues receding into misty blue-gray city blocks; strong natural foreground/interior, midground/window, background/city depth. The office interior frames the expansive city view, with most space devoted to the lovely outside city. A few dusty pink street trees far below and tiny soft ochre taxis can add charm. Warm gentle morning light on the wooden desk, cool distant city. No people.
Style: simple refined crayon-and-pencil storybook drawing, mostly smooth matte pastel fills, delicate slightly irregular outlines, barely visible paper texture. Simplify architecture and objects rather than drawing every window. Crisp enough to feel clean, soft enough to feel drawn by hand. Avoid dense white flecks, heavy rubbed crayon smears, paint streaks, fuzzy watercolor bleed, rough distressed textures, photographic realism, glossy 3D/vector look.
Palette: pale warm ivory, oatmeal, light oak, muted sage, misty blue-gray and a very small amount of dusty rose. Low saturation throughout. Romantic, creative, peaceful and optimistic. Wide landscape composition 3:2, full bleed, no text, no UI, no logo, no border.
